title: Harmonicity and Inharmonicity — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Harmonicity and Inharmonicity's rich face, its first round at Study tier, a proposal: two walks made on the proofs' own model, live, each walking up to the claim it tests, and the 2026-10-17 sweep recordings laid beside the sentences they are the evidence for, tone alone first, as the field guide asks. I grow when the edge is tested on a real instrument; I never hold the entry's words.

offers.what: 'Stretch bites the nth partial roughly as B·n³' is right for the bite (partial n sits B·n³⁄2 above whole for small B), but the edge itself falls more slowly than the cube. On the proofs' model at K = 6 Hz, with the map's rule (hold 4 s, torn past 0.5 Hz wobble), the first tear for 6, 10, 16, 25 and 40 partials falls as N^−2.49 with the sweeps' voices and N^−2.29 with voices exactly on the harmonics; a pure cube would make forty tear 296× sooner than six. Proposed for the bullet and for Open Questions' 'roughly as B·n³': keep the bite at B·n³ and add that the edge falls about as N^2.3 to 2.5 in this model. The scroll already says the model gave 130 to 180× where n³ predicted about 300×.

'40 partials tore over a hundred times sooner than six' holds for the voices the sweeps used, each a hair off its harmonic: 118× at the map's rate (22050 Hz) and 129× at 11025 Hz on this engine, 130 to 180× in the 2026-10-17 runs. With the voices exactly on the harmonic series the same test gives 75×. Proposed: 'over a hundred times sooner than six, with the voices a hair off their harmonics (about 75 times with them exactly on)', or fold it into the page's existing 'the numbers depend on the model'.

'outside voices tuned to the plain harmonic series': in every proof the voices sit up to 0.4% off their harmonics (numpy default_rng(7).uniform(−0.004, 0.004), frustration.py through ride_warm.py), and the scroll's five-scenes entry says 'tuned near'. Proposed: 'tuned near the plain harmonic series, each a hair off'. The shapes stand.

Two findings from the six-against-forty walk's peel, checked headless. With the voices exactly on the harmonics, the voices let go strictly from the top down as stretch rises (2, 8, 14 of 40 gone at B = 5.6e-6, 1e-5, 1.8e-5), and the tone tears by the time about half have gone: a mechanism for 'the top partials set the edge'. With the sweeps' voices, 14 of 40 never hold even at B = 1e-7, since 0.4% of partial 40 is up to 17 Hz, past a 6 Hz pull; so 'frozen' for the tall tone means its pitch holds while a third of its voices never grip. Offered as an addition to the bullet, or to the scroll if the entry should stay short.

pieces.title: One phase, pulled six ways · a walk up to the edge
pieces.caption: **The claim above, run live on the sweeps' own model.** Five steps: the tone alone, six partials on one phase; one voice pulling it, which holds within 12 Hz and slips past; six voices on the harmonics, which agree (push the tone sharp and all six pull back together); a little stretch, where the low voices pull up and the top one down, and the tone settles about 0.5 Hz flat and holds; then the edge, found by ear with the numbers hidden, and only then shown where the map put it. A switch sets the voices a hair off their harmonics, as the sweeps did. Every number the walk shows is re-run headless by `Harmonicity and Inharmonicity — rich — check.mjs`.
pieces.near: Mildly stretched, the tone doesn't fight

verdicts.why: A real test that walks up: one phase alone, one voice, six that agree under a push, a stretch that sags 0.54 Hz and holds, then the edge found blind. The model is edgemap.py's run() line for line, and its revealed edges match an independent Python run (1.68–1.78e-3, 2.11–2.24e-3).

pieces.title: five scenes · the first test, 2026-10-17
pieces.caption: **The asymmetry, heard.** One six-partial tone and six voices near its harmonics (K = 6 Hz), five scenes of 6 s. 0 s: harmonic, locked at 110 Hz. 6.6 s: piano-ish stretch (B 0.0004), still locked, about 0.5 Hz flat. 13.2 s: strong stretch (B 0.004), wandering ±4.4 Hz. 19.8 s: bell-wide (B 0.02), the light tone dragged about 18 Hz flat and wandering ±12.8 Hz. 26.4 s: the same stretch on a heavy master (inertia 60), holding within 0.8 Hz. Tone and voices together; there is no tone-alone take of this one.

pieces.title: the pulse in each scene
pieces.caption: The tone's pulse through the five scenes: the light tone is dragged and wanders; the heavy master barely moves.

verdicts.why: The right evidence beside the asymmetry: scene 5's heavy master holds within 0.8 Hz where the light tone is dragged 18 Hz flat. The caption matches the scroll and says honestly there is no tone-alone take.
The pulse through the five scenes; the caption says only what the plot shows.

pieces.title: the 4× sweep, tone alone · all five places
pieces.caption: **The whole path in one take.** Forty partials, two minutes, the stretch doubling on a steady clock. 0–13 s frozen, then alive: the colour moves, the pitch holds. About 13.5 s: the edge (B ≈ 1.7e-5). 16–28 s: torn, the pitch wobbling 3–6 Hz and diving to about 70 Hz at 24 s. 28–40 s: released, the wobble under 1 Hz by 40 s as the voices lose their grip. From about 52 s the stretched partials have climbed past hearing. Tone alone, as the field guide says to listen first.

pieces.file: Harmonicity and Inharmonicity — rich — six against forty.html
pieces.title: Six against forty · a walk up to how much sooner
pieces.caption: **The bullet above, walked up to and measured.** Five steps: the stretch alone on six partials, where partial n moves about 55·B·n³ Hz; the same on forty; the voices letting go from the top down while the tone holds, then tearing by the time about half are gone; six snapping against forty fraying in two 24 s sweeps; then a guess and a live measurement, by the edge map's own rule, of where 6, 10, 16, 25 and 40 partials first tear. With the sweeps' voices forty tear about 120 to 130 times sooner than six, as the page says; with the voices exactly on the harmonics, about 75. Either way the edge falls about as N^2.3 to 2.5, not the cube. Checked headless by `Harmonicity and Inharmonicity — rich — check.mjs`.
pieces.near: The top partials set the edge

pieces.title: the edge map · four panels
pieces.caption: **The map the sweeps were read against.** Seven couplings by 33 stretches, held 4 s each; dark holds, bright is torn. At K = 6 Hz six partials first tear on this grid at B ≈ 3e-3 and forty at ≈ 1.8e-5. Both walks run this model, and their check reproduces the K = 6 Hz rows of the unpinned panels.
pieces.near: The top partials set the edge

pieces.title: the six-partial sweep, tone alone · the snap
pieces.caption: **Six partials: the bargain, then the snap.** 48 s. For 40 s the pitch holds with almost no wobble and sags slowly, 110 to 107.3 Hz, while the colour turns over: the light tone bargaining by sagging. At 40.75 s (B ≈ 0.0022) it snaps, and the wobble jumps past 2 Hz.

pieces.title: the forty-partial sweep, tone alone · the fray
pieces.caption: **Forty partials: the fray.** One minute, on a log scale. 4–40 s alive: the shape changes while the pitch barely sags (109.9 to 109.5 Hz). About 42 s: the edge (B ≈ 1.7e-5). 44–60 s: the wobble creeps from 0.6 to 2 Hz over many seconds and the pitch slides to 105 Hz. A brighter source than the warm renders, so the top is audible.

pieces.title: the pinned sweep, tone alone · string to bar
pieces.caption: **Pinned: torn, then periodic again.** Partial 1 held while the rest stretch, two minutes. About 13 s: the edge. 16–24 s: torn, diving to about 84 Hz. 28–32 s: relocked. 32–52 s: the bar arrives, partials 2 to 5 moving from 2.73, 5.44, 9.2, 14.0 to 4, 9, 16, 25. From 52 s a steady bar tone whose waveform repeats again.

verdicts.why: The five places in one take, tone alone first; the edge time and B match sweep4x-report.json (13.48 s, 1.72e-5).

verdicts.file: Harmonicity and Inharmonicity — rich — six against forty.html
verdicts.why: A real test with a good walk up, and its disagreements with the text are honest offers. But step 2's tryText says the 6 Hz line marks where every partial would need more than one voice's reach: false on the model (lone reach 12 Hz; at B 1e-5, 18 partials bite past 6 Hz but only 8 voices let go). Drop or relabel the line, and in step 3 say 'up to about 17 Hz near the top' (partial 40 sits 12.2 Hz off).
The map the sweeps were read against, K = 6 first tears read correctly. Note: 'reproduces' is a little strong, since forty's first tear lands one cell later in the check.
Six partials, the bargain then the snap; 107.3 Hz and 40.75 s at B 0.0022 match sweep-report.json.
Forty partials, the fray; the edge at about 42 s and B 1.7e-5 matches sweep40-report.json. Beside the six-partial sweep it is the sentence 'few snap, many fray'.
Pinned stretch, string to bar and periodic again, beside the sentence it is evidence for; the ratios match the scroll.

pieces.title: breathing across the edge · warm tone alone
pieces.caption: **Breathing across it.** 48 s at K = 6 Hz, the stretch swinging on a log curve through the warm tone's edge and back, peaking at 6, 18, 30 and 42 s: a tear-and-heal phrase every 12 s.

pieces.title: gestures at the edge · warm tone alone
pieces.caption: **Striking past it and stepping through it.** 34 s. 0–10 s: the stretch wobbles three times a second across the edge, a flutter that never quite relocks. 10–21 s: a strike every 1.25 s throws the stretch far past the edge and lets it decay (τ ≈ 0.25 s); each tears and heals, a pitch drop made by the physics, with no envelope drawn. 21–34 s: an eight-step sequence through frozen, alive, edge and torn; only the steps above the edge tear, so the boundary plays as a rhythm.

pieces.title: coupling as the knob · warm tone alone
pieces.caption: **More coupling pushes the edge out, heard.** 40 s with the stretch held just past the edge while coupling swings 2 → 18 → 2 Hz twice, tightest at 10 and 30 s. The tone locks near the top of each swing and tears near 0, 20 and 40 s.

verdicts.why: Breathing across the edge, the first of the three plays the answer names; its timings match the scroll.
Striking past and stepping through, the other two plays; its timings match the scroll.
'More coupling pushes it out', heard: at a fixed stretch, coupling alone decides lock or tear.
